name: Wall Push-Up
instructions: Stand arm's length from a wall with hands flat at shoulder height. Bend your elbows to bring your chest toward the wall, then press back to the start.
coaching_cue: Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels — avoid letting your hips sag or pike up.
common_mistakes: Flaring elbows out wide, rounding the upper back, not using full range of motion.
modification: Step closer to the wall to reduce the angle.
advanced_progression: Move to incline push-ups with hands on a bench or step.

name: Incline Push-Up
instructions: Place hands on a bench or sturdy elevated surface, slightly wider than shoulders. Lower your chest toward the bench, then press back up.
coaching_cue: Squeeze your glutes and brace your core throughout to keep a straight body line.
common_mistakes: Hands too far forward, letting hips drop, partial range of motion.
modification: Use a higher surface like a countertop.

name: Dumbbell Chest Press
instructions: Lie on a bench holding dumbbells above your chest with arms extended. Lower the weights to the sides of your chest, then press back up.
coaching_cue: Keep your feet flat on the floor and a slight arch in your lower back. Control the lowering phase.
common_mistakes: Bouncing weights off the chest, uneven arm movement, losing shoulder blade contact with the bench.
modification: Use lighter weights or perform the floor press variation.
low_impact_alternative: Floor chest press with lighter weights.
advanced_progression: Increase weight progressively or add a pause at the bottom.

name: Dumbbell Overhead Press
instructions: Stand or sit holding dumbbells at shoulder height with palms facing forward. Press the weights overhead until arms are fully extended, then lower with control.
coaching_cue: Brace your core and avoid arching your back as you press up.
common_mistakes: Excessive lower back arch, pressing unevenly, not locking out at the top.
modification: Seated version to reduce core demand, or use lighter weights.
advanced_progression: Arnold press variation or increase weight.

name: Floor Push-Up
instructions: Start in a plank position with hands slightly wider than shoulders. Lower your chest to the floor, then press back up.
coaching_cue: Keep your core braced and body in one line. Don't let your hips drop or pike up.
common_mistakes: Sagging hips, flared elbows past 45 degrees, incomplete range of motion.
advanced_progression: Tempo push-ups with a 3-second lowering phase.

name: Bench Tricep Dip
instructions: Sit on a bench edge with hands beside your hips. Slide your hips off the bench and lower your body by bending your elbows to about 90 degrees, then press back up.
coaching_cue: Keep your back close to the bench and avoid shrugging your shoulders up to your ears.
common_mistakes: Going too deep (stresses shoulders), flaring elbows outward, rushing the movement.
modification: Keep feet closer to the bench with knees bent.
advanced_progression: Extend legs straight out to increase difficulty.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand holding light dumbbells at your sides. Raise the weights out to the sides until your arms are parallel to the floor, then lower with control.
coaching_cue: Lead with your elbows, not your hands. Think about pouring a pitcher of water at the top.
common_mistakes: Shrugging the shoulders, swinging the weights, going too heavy.
modification: Use lighter weights or raise only to 45 degrees.
advanced_progression: Add a 2-second hold at the top or increase weight.
